scope: Two original-executable 80 s runs, B1 and DM065, p20183 (i=144,j=142,k=4, owner rank 5), bounded to the seventh target calc_p_rho_phi call. No source/executable modifications, no physics policy change and no pre-emptive claim of source association.

candidate_machine_sequence.0x2157072: candidate AL vector store, pre-store snapshot

bounded_strategy: At the seventh target phi entry verify real caller, kdm completion, bounds, branch and four recorded input words. Use a hardware READ watch on the target PH(k) word to arm an otherwise disabled instruction prepoint. At that prepoint, accept only a vector whose prospective AL store range contains the exact target AL address; derive lane from the effective address, and then capture relevant XMM words and exact instruction bytes at each fixed operation and AL store. This avoids a domain-wide unconditional breakpoint. If the watched read arrives too late, vector condition does not match, scalar path occurs, or expected order is missing, fail closed rather than infer.
event_contract: For each stop record ordinal, target coordinates, raw register/vector lanes and memory effective addresses, exact executable bytes, PH/PHB words, numerator results after each operation and pre/post AL store word. Recompute each observed operation in source and actual instruction order as float32; verify final selected vector lane equals stored AL. The active breakpoint is for a single matching target vector and disarms afterward.
mandatory_gates: Original executable/source/runtime profile and 89 inputs unchanged; each h00 history byte-identical to frozen phase0.
Four target KDM ENTRY/RETURN 16-field byte checks and phi event/boundary checks against existing verified target capture.
Expected seventh target phi caller/branch/inputs and arithmetic PC sequence verified; no missing records or assumed lane.
AL effective store address and four-byte selected lane prove the captured arithmetic belongs to target AL; before-store OUT AL is not interpreted.
No change to frozen phi source/probe/receipt; candidate grouping remains source-replay hypothesis until actual machine observations and independent arithmetic review.
